title: Astro Boy: Omega Factor
subtitle: Tezuka’s small robot meets a much larger cast
summary: Astro Boy: Omega Factor is Treasure and Hitmaker's Game Boy Advance action game sending Osamu Tezuka's robot hero through a journey populated by characters from across the creator's work. Close-range fighting mixes with flight and shooting, allowing Astro's different abilities to change the pace between stages. The supporting cast gives the adventure a wider identity than a simple retelling of one television episode. Meeting people becomes part of Astro's development, connecting the action with the empathy and relationships at the centre of a hero who is powerful but still learning about the world around him.
body: Astro Boy: Omega Factor is Treasure and Hitmaker's Game Boy Advance action game sending Osamu Tezuka's robot hero through a journey populated by characters from across the creator's work. Close-range fighting mixes with flight and shooting, allowing Astro's different abilities to change the pace between stages. The supporting cast gives the adventure a wider identity than a simple retelling of one television episode. Meeting people becomes part of Astro's development, connecting the action with the empathy and relationships at the centre of a hero who is powerful but still learning about the world around him.

Astro punches, kicks and uses his laser to deal with enemies, gradually filling the EX gauge through successful attacks. The stored energy powers stronger techniques, including attacks capable of affecting several opponents at once. Flight sections use his rocket abilities to change the arrangement of the action, moving from a close exchange to threats approached through the air. The abilities work as parts of one character rather than separate equipment choices. The player learns when ordinary attacks can build the resource needed and when the current group of enemies justifies spending it.

Encounters with the wider cast contribute to the Omega Factor, connecting Astro's growth with the people he meets during the journey. Character development therefore has a narrative form alongside its practical effect on the action. The game draws on Tezuka's recurring use of recognisable characters across different stories, bringing that larger creative world into one portable adventure. Its stages supply immediate threats, but the developing record of relationships gives another reason to explore what surrounds them. Astro becomes stronger through understanding and meeting others, making the collection fit the particular hero at its centre.
story_headings: Tezuka’s small robot meets a much larger cast
A successful attack prepares something larger
A meeting becomes part of the Omega Factor
